- The Art of War: 4B views, 1.6M followers
- Wholesome Wendy: 2.2B views, 1.4M followers

Post, post, post - no results, but your content is a little bit better.

Post, post, post - you've gone viral, your channel explodes, gets monetized, and scales.

Keep posting.
